description: Family-disjoint holdout for live broadcast studio operations.

units.title: Tally light
units.text: A visual indicator on or near a camera that shows when that camera is selected for program output, helping presenters and operators know which lens is live.

units.title: Live camera cuts
units.text: During a live programme, the vision director calls the camera changes and the switcher operator executes those cuts on the production switcher.

units.title: Contribution feed delay
units.text: A remote contribution feed is monitored before going live because unstable latency can cause talk-over and make presenter handoffs sound unnatural.

units.title: Unexpected silence
units.text: If the programme output becomes unexpectedly silent, the transmission operator verifies the program bus and backup source before switching to emergency audio.

units.title: Radio microphone handoff
units.text: The floor manager issues each radio microphone to the assigned presenter before rehearsal and checks that it is muted before the presenter enters the studio.

units.text:
